scope: 固定上游Transformers v4.51.3实现 + ArenaLabs checkpoint缓存config的依赖结构核查；不是已锁定历史runtime版本，也未运行模型加载/数值等价验证。
notation: B为文本批次；L为token长度（不是动作帧数）；W[a→b]表示输入a、输出b的Linear。RMS(x)=gamma*x/sqrt(mean(x²)+1e-6)，不减均值、无beta；LN另减均值且有gamma/beta。所有公式按冻结eval路径写，dropout=identity。

encoders.name: SigLIP text tower
encoders.defaults_resolution: cacheconfig未显式存layers/activation/epsilon；按v4.51.3 SiglipTextConfig缺省解析为12/gelu_pytorch_tanh/1e-6。projection_size缺省hidden_size。不是声称已验证历史runtime。

blocks.name: Pre-LN self-attention ×12
blocks.computation: U=LN(H); Q=U Wq+bq,K=U Wk+bk,V=U Wv+bv; A=softmax(QK^T/8+M_padding); H←H+concat(A V) Wo+bo; 所有Linear768→768，双向无causal mask

blocks.name: Final LN, last-position head
blocks.computation: Z=LN(H); e=Linear[768→768](Z[:,-1,:]); tokenizer sticky-EOS假设下取最后位置，非搜索argmax/EOS索引

blocks.name: AlphaMotion normalization + cache
blocks.computation: get_text_features仅返回上述head输出；调用端e←e/||e||₂，再按joint name缓存。图不应加入SigLIP vision tower。

encoders.pseudocode:
H = token(ids) + position(ids)
for layer in layers_12:
    H = H + layer.attn(layer.ln1(H), pad_mask)
    H = H + layer.fc2(gelu_tanh(layer.fc1(layer.ln2(H))))
e = head(final_ln(H)[:, -1])
return normalize(e, dim=-1) # AlphaMotion caller

encoders.name: FLAN-T5-base encoder only

blocks.name: Shared token embedding; no absolute position
Pre-RMS self-attention ×12
blocks.computation: U=RMS(H); Q=UWq,K=UWk,V=UWv; A=softmax(QK^T+R_bucket+M_padding); H←H+concat(A V) Wo；Q/K/V/O均768→768且无bias；没有除sqrt(64)

blocks.name: Relative position bias once, reused ×12
blocks.computation: bucket(j−i)：双向各16桶，小距离0..7精确，大距离按max_distance128做对数分桶并截断到该方向的最后一桶；只有第一个block拥有表，其position_bias张量后续层复用

blocks.name: Pre-RMS gated-GELU FFN ×12
blocks.computation: U=RMS(H); G=GELU_new(U Wi0) ⊙ (U Wi1); H←H+G Wo；Wi0/Wi1:768→2048，Wo:2048→768，全部无bias

blocks.name: Final RMS and caller pooling
blocks.computation: Z=RMS(H); pooled=sum_i(mask_i Z_i)/max(sum_i mask_i,1)；pool=False输出完整Z及调用方保留mask；空文本mask全0使pooled=0；无额外L2归一化

encoders.pseudocode:
H = token(ids)
R = first_layer.relative_bias(bucket(j - i)) + pad_mask
for layer in encoder_layers_12:
    U = rms1(H)
    H = H + Wo(softmax(Q(U) @ K(U).T + R) @ V(U))
    U = rms2(H)
    H = H + Wffo(gelu_new(Wi0(U)) * Wi1(U))
Z = final_rms(H)
return Z if not pool else masked_mean(Z, mask)
notes: 缓存或cross-attention路径可先pool=False存token，再在adaLN分支求相同masked mean。
第一层bias共享证据：T5Stack第896行仅i==0，1153–1158行传递position_bias。
gated-gelu→gelu_new映射在configuration_t5.py:135–136；不是ReLU FFN，也不是SiLU SwiGLU。

encoders.name: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B base model

blocks.name: Embedding
blocks.computation: Embed[151669,1024]；AlphaMotion左padding，所有样本最后位置都要求有效；无learned绝对position embedding

blocks.name: Pre-RMS Q/K/V and per-head QK-RMS ×28
blocks.computation: U=RMS(H); Q=RMS_128(reshape(U Wq)); K=RMS_128(reshape(U Wk)); V=reshape(U Wv)。Wq:1024→2048；Wk,Wv:1024→1024；Q/K专用RMS各有128维gain、跨heads广播。

blocks.name: RoPE then causal grouped-query attention ×28
blocks.computation: 先对Q/K施加RoPE(theta=1e6)，再重复K/V到16heads；A=softmax(Q_rot K_rot^T/sqrt(128)+M_causal+M_padding)；H←H+concat(A V) Wo，Wo:2048→1024。Q/K/V/O无bias。

blocks.name: Final RMS, last token, caller L2
blocks.computation: Z=RMS(H); e=Z[:,-1,:]; e←e/||e||₂。AutoModel返回hidden states，不运行词表LMhead；不使用mean pooling。

encoders.pseudocode:
H = token(left_padded_ids)
for layer in decoder_layers_28:
    U = rms1(H)
    Q = rope(q_norm(split16(Wq(U)))) # head_dim=128
    K = rope(k_norm(split8(Wk(U))))
    V = split8(Wv(U))
    A = softmax(Q @ repeat2(K).T / sqrt(128) + causal_pad_mask)
    H = H + Wo(concat(A @ repeat2(V)))
    U = rms2(H)
    H = H + Wdown(silu(Wgate(U)) * Wup(U))
return normalize(final_rms(H)[:, -1], dim=-1)
notes: 不要用hidden_size/heads=64覆盖checkpoint显式head_dim128；Q总宽度确实大于residual hidden。
逐层预RMS与最终RMS都是1024维，Q/K专用RMS是128维。
